nodes.label: CI Workflow (verify job)
nodes.rationale: Runs npm ci + npm run ci on every PR to main and all pushes except gh-pages, keeping main green before merge.

nodes.label: Deploy to GitHub Pages Workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds with npm run ci and uploads dist/ as a Pages artifact on push to main; concurrency group 'pages' cancels in-progress deploys.

nodes.label: Project graphify usage rules (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return scoped subgraphs, much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds graph once per commit via AST only; no background process, editor-agnostic. Docs/images ignored.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion (Step 0)
nodes.rationale: CLI matcher is literal case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms, so questions must be translated into graph vocabulary first.

nodes.label: build_merge replace-on-re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); drops re-extracted source files before merge so stale nodes do not survive (#1344).

nodes.label: Part C merge AST + semantic extraction
nodes.norm_label: part c merge ast + semantic extraction

nodes.label: Fast path: query existing graph.json
nodes.rationale: Skip detect/extract when graph already built and the request is a natural-language question; saves cost.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges (use AMBIGUOUS), always show token cost, show raw cohesion scores, warn on >5000-node HTML viz.

nodes.label: Manifest stamping of semantic files
nodes.rationale: Only stamp semantic files that produced output so failed chunks are re-queued on next --update (#2015, #1948).

nodes.label: Part B parallel semantic subagent extraction
nodes.norm_label: part b parallel semantic subagent extraction

nodes.label: #479 shrink-guard on graph.json export
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write when new graph is smaller than existing, so an empty extraction never clobbers a good graph.

nodes.label: Part A structural AST extraction
nodes.rationale: Code is covered deterministically by AST, so only content files go to semantic subagents (#1392).
